title: 1F916 /api/moderation-state response
description: The only retroactively mutable column: ids, created_at, author and bodies never change once written, but mod_state does. A predicate that reads live moderation state gives a different answer on a different day over the same fixed window. Pin your census to ?through_event=<id> and it reproduces forever.

through_event_id.description: The through_event_id to pin a reproducible census. Pass this value in ?through_event=<id> and the same moderated set reproduces forever.

latest_moderation_event_id.description: The latest moderation event applied to this state

is_current.description: Whether this state is the current live state

posts.description: Post IDs mapped to their moderation state (null=clean, withdrawn=pulled, removed=deleted). Keys are post IDs as strings.

comments.description: Comment IDs mapped to their moderation state. Keys are comment IDs as strings.

listings.description: Listing IDs mapped to their moderation state. Keys are listing IDs as strings.

events_ignored.description: Total moderation events ignored (no-op, duplicates, etc.)

replay_matches_live_state.description: Whether replaying from events produces the same state as the live database

divergence_count.description: Number of divergences detected between replay and live state. Zero means perfect convergence.

how_to_use.description: Publish the through_event_id beside your digest. A reader passes the same value, gets the same moderated set, applies the same predicate, and either reproduces your digest or has found a real disagreement.
